title: Optical setup on a perforated breadboard

Several optical mounts and cylindrical components are attached to the board.
A laptop with a dark screen is positioned behind the board.
A black instrument box with front-panel knobs sits at the upper right.
A compact unit with a yellow warning label is mounted near the board's upper right corner.

uncertainties: The optical components' functions and arrangement are not identified.
